title: The Voyage of the Beagle
author: Charles Darwin
description: "The Voyage of the Beagle" by Charles Darwin is a book published in 1839, chronicling the five-year HMS Beagle expedition around the world.
longDescription: Part travel memoir and part scientific journal, it documents Darwin's keen observations of biology, geology, and anthropology across distant lands.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Darwin (1809–1882) wrote The Voyage of the Beagle. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
works: Journal of Researches into the Natural History and Geology of the Countries Visited During the Voyage Round the World of H.M.S. Beagle Under the Command of Captain Fitz Roy, R.N.
